sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This is our first day at a new school.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s meet some of the students and teachers at Sunshine Middle School, and learn how to greet others and introduce ourselves.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlets ˈmiːt ˌsʌm ɒv ðə ˈstjuːdnts ænd ˈtiːtʃəz æt ˈsʌnʃaɪn ˈmɪdəl ˈskuːl, ænd ˈlɜːn ˌhaʊ tə ˈgriːt ˈʌðəz ænd ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs aʊəˈselvz./
sentences.meaning: 让我们认识阳光中学的一些学生和老师，并学习如何问候他人和介绍自己。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here are some students from Class 1, Grade 7 and their English teacher, Mr Wu.
sentences.ipa: /ˈhɪə ɑː ˌsʌm ˈstjuːdnts frɒm ˈklɑːs ˈwʌn, ˈgreɪd ˈsevən ænd ðeə ˈɪŋglɪʃ ˈtiːtʃə, ˈmɪstə wuː./
sentences.meaning: 这里有一些来自七年级1班的学生，以及他们的英语老师吴老师。

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Hello, my name is Chen Dan, and Daniel is my English name.
sentences.ipa: /həˈləʊ, maɪ ˈneɪm ɪz tʃən dæn, ænd ˈdænjəl ɪz maɪ ˈɪŋglɪʃ ˈneɪm./

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: Hi, I'm Zhao Min. My English name is Amy.
sentences.ipa: /ˈhaɪ, ˌaɪm dʒaʊ mɪn. ˌmaɪ ˈɪŋglɪʃ ˈneɪm ɪz ˈeɪmiː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Please greet and introduce each other.

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Hi, my name is Zhang Ke. You can call me Kitty.
sentences.ipa: /ˈhaɪ, maɪ ˈneɪm ɪz dʒɑːŋ kɜː. ˌjuː kæn ˈkɔːl ˌmiː ˈkɪtiː./

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Good morning. I'm Luo Yang. You can call me Simon.
sentences.ipa: /ˈgʊd ˈmɔːnɪŋ. ˌaɪm lwɔː jɑːŋ. ˌjuː kæn ˈkɔːl ˌmiː saɪmən./

sentences.speaker: sandy

sentences.ipa: /həˈləʊ, ˌaɪm wɑːŋ ʃɪn jweɪ, ænd ˌaɪ ˌgəʊ baɪ ˈmɪliː./
sentences.meaning: 你好，我是王欣悦，大家也叫我 Millie。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Greet your partner and then introduce yourself.
sentences.ipa: /ˈgriːt jɔː ˈpɑːtnə ænd ˈðen ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs jɔːˈself./

sentences.meaning: “早上”是“早上好”的非正式说法。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.meaning: 我是 Millie。你叫什么名字？

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: My name is Sandy. Nice to meet you!
sentences.ipa: /ˌmaɪ ˈneɪm ɪz ˈsændiː. ˈnaɪs tə ˈmiːt juː!/
sentences.meaning: 我叫 Sandy。很高兴认识你！

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Glad to meet you too! Which class are you in?

sentences.meaning: 我也很高兴认识你！你在哪个班？

sentences.meaning: 我在七年级 1 班。你呢？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Wow, we’re in the same class! Do you have any hobbies?
sentences.ipa: /ˈwaʊ, wɪə ɪn ðə ˈseɪm ˈklɑːs! ˈduː juː hæv ˈeniː ˈhɒbiːz?/

sentences.speaker: sandy

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Think of a different greeting and share it with your classmates.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.

sentences.meaning: 在阅读之前，请思考以下问题。

sentences.meaning: 如果句子为真，则写 T；如果句子为假，则写 F。

sentences.meaning: B 再读一遍米莉的介绍。

sentences.text: 4 Sandy is a tall, polite girl.

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: He is very nice and always

sentences.text: You can write them in the following order.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Write some sentences about yourself or one of your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː ˈraɪt ˌsʌm ˈsentənsɪz əˈbaʊt jɔːˈself ɔː ˈwʌn ɒv jɔː ˈklɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: D 写一些关于您自己或您的一位同学的句子。

sentences.text: Millie sends a message to her old friend Jenny about her new classmates.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read the message and pay attention to the use of the verb be.

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: We use the simple present tense to talk about facts and states.

sentences.meaning: 我们使用一般现在时来谈论事实和状态。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use (am, are, is) with I.
sentences.meaning: 我们将 (am， are， is) 与 I 一起使用。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use (am, are, is) with you, we and they.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈjuːz (æm, ɑː, ɪz) wɪð juː, wiː ænd ðeɪ./
sentences.meaning: you、we 和 they 应与（am、are、is）中的正确形式搭配使用。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use (am, are, is) with he, she and it.

sentences.meaning: 我们用 (am， are， is) 来表示 he、she 和 it。

sentences.text: We make positive and negative sentences using the verb be in the simple present tense like this:

sentences.meaning: 我们使用动词 be 的一般现在时构成肯定句和否定句，如下所示：

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.meaning: 我们使用动词 be 以简单现在时形式提问和回答问题，如下所示：

sentences.meaning: A 这是米莉、她的同学和老师在新学校的一些照片。

sentences.meaning: 用动词 be 的正确形式完成对话。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.meaning: 英语对你来说容易吗，西蒙？

sentences.ipa: /ˈsiː ˈtɔːk wɪð jɔː ˈpɑːtnə əˈbaʊt ˈpiːpəl ænd ˈθɪŋz ɪn jɔː ˈnjuː ˈskuːl, ˈjuːzɪŋ ðə kəˈrekt ˈfɔːmz ɒv ðə ˈvɜːb ˈbiː./
sentences.meaning: C 使用动词 be 的正确形式与您的伙伴谈论新学校中的人和事。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the sounds of the letters a, e, i, o and u.
sentences.ipa: /ˈpeɪ əˈtenʃən tə ðə ˈsaʊndz ɒv ðə ˈletəz ə, ˈiː, ˈaɪ, ˈəʊ ænd ˈjuː/
sentences.meaning: 注意字母 a、e、i、o 和 u 的发音。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then put each one into the correct sound group.
sentences.ipa: /ˈðen ˌpʊt ˈiːtʃ ˈwʌn ˈɪntuː ðə kəˈrekt ˈsaʊnd ˈgruːp./
sentences.meaning: 然后将每个声音放入正确的声音组中。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Try to read the new words according to the sound of the word in the centre in each group.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtraɪ tə ˈriːd ðə ˈnjuː ˈwɜːdz əˈkɔːdɪŋ tə ðə ˈsaʊnd ɒv ðə ˈwɜːd ɪn ðə ˈsentə ɪn ˈiːtʃ ˈgruːp./
sentences.meaning: 尝试根据每组中心单词的发音来读生词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Look at the groups of words.
sentences.ipa: /ˈbiː ˈlʊk æt ðə ˈgruːps ɒv ˈwɜːdz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the sounds of the letters in bold.
sentences.ipa: /ˈpeɪ əˈtenʃən tə ðə ˈsaʊndz ɒv ðə ˈletəz ɪn ˈbəʊld./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 My classmates are all very nice.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌmaɪ ˈklɑːsmeɪts ɑː ˈɔːl ˈveriː ˈnaɪs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Sandy likes listening to piano music.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈsændiː ˈlaɪks ˈlɪsənɪŋ tə pɪˈænəʊ ˈmjuːzɪk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 Simon and Amy go to school by bike.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː saɪmən ænd ˈeɪmiː ˌgəʊ tə ˈskuːl baɪ ˈbaɪk./
sentences.meaning: 4 西蒙和艾米骑自行车去学校。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 These students go home by bus.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv ˌðiːz ˈstjuːdnts ˌgəʊ ˈhəʊm baɪ ˈbʌs./
sentences.meaning: 5 这些学生乘公共汽车回家。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Circle the correct words in the table.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsɜːkəl ðə kəˈrekt ˈwɜːdz ɪn ðə ˈteɪbəl./
sentences.meaning: 在表中圈出正确的单词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Millie is writing about her new friends Kitty and Amy.
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈmɪliː ɪz ˈraɪtɪŋ əˈbaʊt hɜː ˈnjuː ˈfrendz ˈkɪtiː ænd ˈeɪmiː./
sentences.meaning: 米莉正在写她的新朋友凯蒂和艾米的故事。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She is pretty and has lovely eyes.
sentences.ipa: /ˌʃiː ɪz ˈprɪtiː ænd hæz ˈlʌvliː ˈaɪz./
sentences.meaning: 她很漂亮，有一双可爱的眼睛。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 小/可爱/可爱的眼睛/漂亮

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 小/可爱/可爱的眼睛/漂亮

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Listen to their conversation and complete the sentences below.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlɪsən tə ðeə ˌkɒnvəˈseɪʃən ænd kəˈmpliːt ðə ˈsentənsɪz bɪˈləʊ./
sentences.meaning: 听他们的对话并完成下面的句子。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Millie is showing her mum a photo of her new class.
sentences.ipa: /ˈbiː ˈmɪliː ɪz ˈʃəʊɪŋ hɜː ˈmʌm ə ˈfəʊtəʊ ɒv hɜː ˈnjuː ˈklɑːs./
sentences.meaning: B Millie 正在向妈妈展示一张新班级的照片。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Kitty and Amy are Millie’s new friends.
sentences.ipa: /ˈkɪtiː ænd ˈeɪmiː ɑː ˈmɪliːz ˈnjuː ˈfrendz./
sentences.meaning: 凯蒂和艾米是米莉的新朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She has dance classes every week.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie likes her new friends very much.
sentences.ipa: /ˈmɪliː ˈlaɪks hɜː ˈnjuː ˈfrendz ˈveriː ˈmʌtʃ./
sentences.meaning: 米莉非常喜欢她的新朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Millie and Ms Lin, the Music teacher, meet Simon in front of the classroom building.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsiː ˈmɪliː ænd, ðə ˈmjuːzɪk ˈtiːtʃə, ˈmiːt saɪmən ɪn ˈfrʌnt ɒv ðə ˈklɑːsruːm ˈbɪldɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: C Millie 和音乐老师 Lin 老师在教学楼前与 Simon 见面。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in groups of three to greet and introduce each other.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwɜːk ɪn ˈgruːps ɒv ˈθriː tə ˈgriːt ænd ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə./
sentences.meaning: 三人一组，互相问候和介绍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /ˈjuːz ðə ˌkɒnvəˈseɪʃən bɪˈləʊ æz ə ˈmɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: When we introduce two people to each other, we usually introduce the younger to the elder first.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwen wiː ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs ˈtuː ˈpiːpəl tʊ ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə, wiː ˈjuːʒʊəliː ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs ðə ˈjʌŋgə tə ðiː ˈeldə ˈfɜːst./
sentences.meaning: 当我们互相介绍两个人时，我们通常会先将年幼的介绍给年长的。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Hi, Simon. Ms Lin, this is my classmate Simon.

sentences.meaning: 嗨，西蒙。林老师，这是我的同学西蒙。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Simon, this is Ms Lin, our Music teacher.
sentences.meaning: 西蒙，这是我们的音乐老师林老师。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Glad to meet you, Ms Lin.

sentences.speaker: ms lin
sentences.text: Glad to meet you too, Simon.
sentences.meaning: 我也很高兴见到你，西蒙。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Sport helps me stay healthy and happy.
sentences.ipa: /ˈspɔːt ˈhelps ˌmiː ˈsteɪ ˈhelθiː ænd ˈhæpiː./
sentences.meaning: 运动帮助我保持健康和快乐。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I often play football after school.

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Oh, we have a football match with Class 2 at 4:30 this afternoon.
sentences.ipa: /ˈəʊ, wiː hæv ə ˈfʊtbɔːl ˈmætʃ wɪð ˈklɑːs ˈtuː æt ˈfɔː ˈθɜːtiː ðɪs ˌɑːftəˈnuːn./
sentences.meaning: 哦，今天下午四点半我们要和二班进行一场足球比赛。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D To help students learn more about each other, Mr Wu asked every student to write a self-introduction and post it on the school website.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː tə ˈhelp ˈstjuːdnts ˈlɜːn ˈmɔː əˈbaʊt ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə, ˈmɪstə wuː ˈɑːskt ˈevəriː ˈstjuːdnt tə ˈraɪt ə ˌseˌlfɪntrəˈdʌkʃən ænd ˈpəʊst ɪt ˌɒn ðə ˈskuːl ˈwebsaɪt./
sentences.meaning: D 为了让同学们更加了解彼此，吴老师要求每位同学写一份自我介绍，并发布在学校网站上。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete the table with your own information.

sentences.meaning: 用您自己的信息填写表格。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D1 Daniel is making a table to help him write the self-introduction.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː ˈwʌn ˈdænjəl ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə ˈteɪbəl tə ˈhelp ˌhɪm ˈraɪt ðə ˌseˌlfɪntrəˈdʌkʃən./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: D2 这是丹尼尔的自我介绍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: “你好”是一种非正式的问候语。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am Chen Dan from Class 1, Grade 7.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ æm tʃən dæn frɒm ˈklɑːs ˈwʌn, ˈgreɪd ˈsevən./
sentences.meaning: 我是七年级一班的陈丹。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 我的英文名字是丹尼尔。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My favourite subjects are Maths and Computer Science.
sentences.ipa: /ˌmaɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈsʌbdʒekts ɑː ˈmæθs ænd kəˈmpjuːtə ˈsaɪəns./
sentences.meaning: 我最喜欢的科目是数学和计算机科学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am good at them, and I like to help my classmates with Maths problems.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm ˈgʊd æt ˌðem, ænd ˌaɪ ˈlaɪk tə ˈhelp maɪ ˈklɑːsmeɪts wɪð ˈmæθs ˈprɒbləmz./
sentences.meaning: 我很擅长这些，而且我喜欢帮助我的同学解决数学问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I enjoy playing Chinese chess and ping-pong.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɪˈndʒɔɪ ˈpleɪɪŋ ˌtʃaɪˈniːz ˈtʃes ænd ˈpɪŋpɒŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢下中国象棋和乒乓球。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I often play these with my dad at the weekend.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈɒfən ˈpleɪ ðiːz wɪð maɪ ˈdæd æt ðə ˌwiːˈkend./
sentences.meaning: 我经常在周末和爸爸一起玩这些。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I have many new classmates at school.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ hæv ˈmeniː ˈnjuː ˈklɑːsmeɪts æt ˈskuːl./
sentences.meaning: 我在学校有很多新同学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am happy to make friends with them.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm ˈhæpiː tə ˌmeɪk ˈfrendz wɪð ˌðem./
sentences.meaning: 我很高兴能和他们交朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Do you want to be my friend?
sentences.ipa: /ˈduː juː ˈwɒnt tə biː maɪ ˈfrend?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use a comma (,) to pause or separate things in a sentence.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈjuːz ə ˈkɒmə (,) tə ˈpɔːz ɔː ˈsepərət ˈθɪŋz ɪn ə ˈsentəns./
sentences.meaning: 我们使用逗号 (，) 来暂停或分隔句子中的事物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: at the end of a question.

sentences.text: Use Daniel’s self-introduction as a model.
sentences.meaning: 以丹尼尔的自我介绍为范本。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D3 Write your own self-introduction based on your information in Part D1.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː ˈθriː ˈraɪt jɔː ˈəʊn ˌseˌlfɪntrəˈdʌkʃən ˈbeɪst ˌɒn jɔː ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən ɪn ˈpɑːt ˈdiː ˈwʌn./
sentences.meaning: D3 根据 D1 部分中的信息写下您自己的自我介绍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢数学/计算机科学/……

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 I can describe Millie and her new classmates.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˌaɪ kæn dɪˈskraɪb ˈmɪliː ænd hɜː ˈnjuː ˈklɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 1 我可以描述米莉和她的新同学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 I can use the verb be in the simple present tense correctly.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌaɪ kæn ˈjuːz ðə ˈvɜːb biː ɪn ðə ˈsɪmpəl ˈprezənt ˈtens kəˈrektliː./
sentences.meaning: 2 我能正确使用动词be的一般现在时。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 I can introduce myself and my classmates with the new words in this unit.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˌaɪ kæn ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs maɪˈself ænd maɪ ˈklɑːsmeɪts wɪð ðə ˈnjuː ˈwɜːdz ɪn ðɪs ˈjuːnɪt./
sentences.meaning: 3 我能用本单元的生词介绍我自己和我的同学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 I can pronounce the sounds /eɪ/, /iː/, /aɪ/, /əʊ/ and /juː/ correctly in words.
sentences.ipa: /fɔː aɪ kæn prəˈnaʊns ðə saʊndz eɪ, iː, aɪ, əʊ ænd juː kəˈrektlɪ ɪn wɜːdz/
sentences.meaning: 4 我能在单词中正确发音 /eɪ/、/iː/、/aɪ/、/əʊ/ 和 /juː/。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 I know how to greet others and make new friends at a new school.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv ˌaɪ ˈnəʊ ˌhaʊ tə ˈgriːt ˈʌðəz ænd ˌmeɪk ˈnjuː ˈfrendz æt ə ˈnjuː ˈskuːl./
sentences.meaning: 5 我知道如何在新学校与他人打招呼并结交新朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: * Assess your learning of new words and grammar by doing the exercises on page 106.
sentences.ipa: /əˈses jɔː ˈlɜːnɪŋ ɒv ˈnjuː ˈwɜːdz ænd ˈgræmə baɪ ˈduːɪŋ ðiː ˈeksəsaɪzɪz ˌɒn ˈpeɪdʒ ˈwʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈsɪks./
sentences.meaning: * 通过第 106 页的练习来评估您对新单词和语法的学习情况。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I need to spend more time on.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈniːd tə ˈspend ˈmɔː ˈtaɪm ˌɒn./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Don’t use a nickname if the person does not ask you to.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdəʊnt ˈjuːz ə ˈnɪkneɪm ɪf ðə ˈpɜːsən ˈdʌz ˌnɒt ˈɑːsk juː tuː./
sentences.meaning: 如果对方没有要求，请不要使用昵称。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon has a friend called William Smith.
sentences.ipa: /saɪmən hæz ə ˈfrend ˈkɔːld ˈwɪljəm ˈsmɪθ./
sentences.meaning: 西蒙有一个朋友，名叫威廉·史密斯。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His parents and friends often call him “Will”.
sentences.ipa: /ˌhɪz ˈpeərənts ænd ˈfrendz ˈɒfən ˈkɔːl ˌhɪm “ˈwɪl”./
sentences.meaning: 他的父母和朋友经常叫他“威尔”。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here are some nicknames for popular English names.
sentences.ipa: /ˈhɪə ɑː ˌsʌm ˈnɪkneɪmz fɔː ˈpɒpjʊlə ˈɪŋglɪʃ ˈneɪmz./
sentences.meaning: 以下是一些流行英文名字的昵称。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Find out more fun facts about names and share them with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪnd ˈaʊt ˈmɔː ˈfʌn ˈfækts əˈbaʊt ˈneɪmz ænd ˈʃeə ˌðem wɪð jɔː ˈklɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 查找更多有关名字的有趣事实并与同学分享。
